description: Upload one HTML/code payload and get a public share URL plus an edit token. Each call creates a new asset unless idempotencyKey is reused. Anonymous uploads are rate-limited to 10/hour and 50/day per IP; authenticated uploads are limited per account. Content is public unless password-protected and expires after expiresIn (default 7d). Use upload_site for multi-file sites, view to read back, list_assets for your own files, or delete to remove one.

content.description: HTML or code to publish (required, max 500 KB).

filename.description: Optional display filename used in the title and download name (max 200 chars).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional 1-128 char retry key. Reusing it with the same payload returns the original asset; the edit token is only returned to the original caller.

language.description: Content language hint, e.g. html, css, js, json, markdown. Default html.

password.description: Optional password; the web view asks for it before showing content.

title.description: Optional title shown in the viewer and gallery metadata.

name: upload
